Class GameState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.game.GameState
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameState extends Object implements Serializable
GameState: The root aggregate of the game model and the Context of the State Pattern. It manages the lifecycle of Players, Board, and Deck, and delegates phase-specific logic to GamePhaseBehavior implementations.

    • requireEnoughConnectedPlayers

      private void requireEnoughConnectedPlayers(Player culprit)
      Ensures the game has enough connected players to allow a move: a single connected player cannot play alone. When violated, raises GameEvent.Type.INSUFFICIENT_PLAYERS and throws, so the controller rejects the move (returns false).
      Parameters:
      culprit - the player attempting the move
      Throws:
      IllegalMoveException - if fewer than 2 players are connected

    • publishTrigger

      public boolean publishTrigger(TriggerKey key)
      Publishes a trigger: for each active player (orderTileOrder), activates all buildings that match the given trigger key. This mechanism is distinct from error/event broadcast via raiseEvent(GameEvent).
      Parameters:
      key - The trigger key (e.g. END_TURN, HUNTER_EVENT, etc.)
      Returns:
      true if the trigger is iterated correctly, false on invalid input

    • disconnectPlayer

      public boolean disconnectPlayer(Player player)
      Marks a player as disconnected. Does NOT raise PLAYER_DISCONNECTED: the controller raises it after the current phase has skipped the player's turn, so the snapshot carried to clients reflects the post-skip state.
      Parameters:
      player - the player leaving
      Returns:
      true if the player belonged to this game and was marked disconnected
